header.blockIdPrefix: A Block ID starts with STR- or EVT-
header.blockIdFormat: A Block ID has four groups of four characters after the prefix

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: What the WAF decided on your routes, from the events the nodes sent.
overview.chartLabel: Events per time bucket, stacked by verdict
overview.routeNote: host and first two path segments
overview.clientsHidden: Client IPs are shown to operators, approvers and admins.

inspection.title: Requests not fully inspected
inspection.breakdown: CPU budget {{partial}} · body not inspected {{body}} · engine error {{error}} · degraded {{degraded}}
inspection.empty: No request counts yet: nodes send them from module and agent RV-N-01 on.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Requests the WAF blocked, would have blocked in shadow, or logged. Select a row for its decision trace.

table.empty: No events match these filters. Widen the time range or clear a filter.

detail.missingHelp: The event may be older than the retention period (90 days), or the node has not sent it yet. Check the ID the user gave you, then try again in a minute.

summary.block: Blocked by policy {{policy}} (version {{version}}) with an anomaly score of {{score}} from {{count}} matching rules.
summary.shadow: Policy {{policy}} (version {{version}}) is in shadow mode: this request would have been blocked with an anomaly score of {{score}} from {{count}} matching rules, and was let through.
summary.pass: Passed by policy {{policy}} (version {{version}}). Anomaly score {{score}} from {{count}} matching rules.
summary.error: The engine failed on this request under policy {{policy}} (version {{version}}); the fail mode decided its fate.

detail.noViolations: No match details were recorded for this event.
detail.viewerNotice: You are signed in as a viewer: client IPs and matched input are hidden, also in CSV exports.
detail.sameIp: Events from this client IP, last 7 days

inspection.partial: Not fully inspected: the CPU budget ran out and the fail mode applied. Rules after that point did not run.
inspection.body_skipped: The request body, or part of it, was not inspected (over the inspection limit or spooled to disk).

login.tagline: Every blocked request has an ID, and every ID has a reason.
login.taglineNote: Look up a Block ID, see what matched and where, and decide what to do next.
login.title: Sign in to Strata
login.subtitle: Use your organization’s single sign-on account.
login.subtitleLocal: Sign in with your Strata account.
login.subtitleBoth: Sign in with your Strata account or your organization’s single sign-on.
login.badCredentials: Wrong username or password, or the account is locked or disabled.
login.throttled: Too many attempts from this address. Try again in a few minutes.
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check that the control plane is reachable.

errors.apiUnreachable: Cannot reach the control plane API. Check that it is running, then refresh.
errors.blockIdConnection: Lost the connection while looking up {{id}}. Check your network, then try again.

policies.title: Policies
policies.subtitle: Policies and their version history. Operators edit a policy as a draft version; deploying stays a separate step.
policies.pick: Select a policy to see its versions.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.subtitle: Nodes by connector group, their versions and bundle, and the rollout in progress. Refreshes every 3 seconds.
fleet.empty: No node has enrolled yet. Create an enrollment token for a connector group, then run strata-agent enroll on the node.

account.title: Change password
account.done: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Local accounts that sign in with a password. Every change is in the audit log.
users.subtitleBoth: Local accounts that sign in with a password. Single sign-on accounts are managed at your identity provider.
users.notEnabled: Local accounts are not enabled on this control plane (-local-auth).
users.disabledLabel: Disabled: cannot sign in, sessions end
users.resetPassword: Set a new password (optional, at least {{min}} characters)

editor.title: Edit {{name}} (from version {{version}})
editor.draftNote: Saving makes a new version in draft: nodes keep the deployed version until it is deployed.
editor.allowedCodes: Check the response status against the allowed codes
editor.dbErrors: Find database error messages in the body
editor.conflict: Someone saved this policy in the meantime. Close the editor, reopen the policy and redo the change.

yamlErr.tab: tabs are not allowed, indent with spaces
yamlErr.responseNext: the keys of response go on the next lines
yamlErr.guard: data_guard accepts cccd and jwt, got "{{value}}"
yamlErr.canary: canary_percent is a number from 0.01 to 99.99 with at most two decimals

editor.canaryNote: Empty: every client. Clients outside the canary run in shadow; the control plane forces shadow if the canary does worse than its shadow group.

diff.title: Compare versions of {{name}}
diff.same: Both sides are the same version.
diff.none: The two versions are the same.

key.oversize: Request body larger than what is inspected
